hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s re-election bid and economic defense
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei's re-election campaign and economic policies dominate coverage, with intense focus on his legislative strategy, approval ratings, and controversial statements. Key legislative battles include Central Bank reform and fiscal innocence laws, while his government faces criticism over economic hardship and debt crises.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to Milei’s polarizing leadership style, high-stakes economic reforms, and the emotional investment in Argentina’s economic future under his libertarian agenda.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) party is surging in polls, particularly in eastern states like Saxony-Anhalt, where it is poised to win its first state government. Coverage highlights AfD’s controversial policies, including calls to exit the Eurozone and Schengen, mass deportations, and opposition to public broadcasting.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to fears of far-right governance, moral panic over migration, and the potential for Germany’s political landscape to shift dramatically.
